package com.brewbox.cart

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow

class FakeCartRepository : CartRepository {
    val linesFlow = MutableStateFlow<List<CartLine>>(emptyList())
    var failNextCheckout = false

    override fun observeLines(): Flow<List<CartLine>> = linesFlow

    override suspend fun lines(): List<CartLine> = linesFlow.value

    override suspend fun checkout(): CheckoutResult =
        if (failNextCheckout) CheckoutResult.Declined else CheckoutResult.Ok("order-1")
}
